name: spotlight-card4
title: Proximity Spotlight Card
blurb: Spotlight card with proximity-based spotlight tracking.
description: A card using ProximitySpotlight mode. Spotlight appears based on pointer proximity to the card (not just on hover). Includes image, title, and tech stack description.
use_when: Interactive dashboards or galleries where proximity-based spotlight creates a subtle, ambient effect as users browse.
avoid_when: Static or non-interactive layouts where proximity effects add unnecessary complexity.
a11y: Text is readable. Spotlight is ambient visual feedback. Pointer proximity is not a semantic interaction.
